name: pixel-art
description: Pixel art, sprite sheets and 2D tilemaps (Aseprite, Tiled, LDtk): the export and format traps a model gets wrong. Aseprite CLI option order, the json-hash default, frameTags that drift under --ignore-empty or --tag, trimmed-frame offsets, Pillow's dithering palette defaults, Tiled GID flip bits, compressed or external tilesets Phaser skips with only a warning, tile-object anchors, LDtk __ fields and stale auto-layer tiles. Plus two stdlib checkers with exit codes: sheet PNG against its JSON, and map references, GIDs and layer formats.
